_readme: One file per song per version: deliveries/<Song>/session/mix_config_vN.json. EVERY parameter needs value + why (the measurement that justified it, on THIS song) + source (measured | reference | artist_request | carried_from_vN) + since (version it was set/changed). Values here are placeholders (null) on purpose: never copy numbers from another song.

title.why: Kenshin named the song in the group chat (fresh run)

bpm.why: tempo_key.py on the beat: 135.00 (alts 67.5/90). Long self-match of the beat (1-6 kHz band) at 8-96 bars: 96-bar drift -0.01..0.00 samples (corr 0.92-0.97), fit 135.0000. Snare on beat 3 = half-time feel; counted as 135 (trap convention), 67.5 is the same grid at half speed. Beat = 19600 samples, bar = 78400 samples exactly at 44.1 kHz

grid_t0_sec.why: snare (1.5-4 kHz crack, beat 3) 50%-attack offset, median over 75 full-drum bars, IQR 182-183 samples. Detector bias on a synthetic snare +85 samples and kick body rise gives ~236 after bias correction, so true T0 is ~100-240 samples (2-5 ms). Not from hats

key.value: F major note set (relative D minor); tonic ambiguous F major vs G minor/Dorian
key.why: beat chroma best F major 0.83 (next G minor 0.68); tempo_key.py D minor 0.813 vs F major 0.810 (low conf). 808 loop G-Bb-F-C, 2 bars each (Gm-Bb-F-C), starts on G. Sung pitch classes mostly Bb/G/A/C/F, no Eb, no E. Confidence: medium on notes, low on tonic

sections.name: Bridge: Background lead / BG2 trade 2 bars

reference_tracks.title: W.O.W (Walkin On Water) - Chris Travis
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

reference_tracks.title: FijiFalls - Chris Travis x Bones
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

reference_tracks.title: I Don't Wanna Do This Anymore - XXXTENTACION
reference_tracks.valid_reason: 16-bit/44.1k but spectrum stops ~15-16 kHz (made from lossy sources): used loosely for top end; no vocal stems, so no vocal-pocket delta can be read from them

value.approach: throws only on line ends followed by a measured gap, timed from the stressed-vowel P-center + exact note value (main) with grid-locked A/B, 2-3 repeats fading where the gap allows

echoes.why: Kenshin (group chat 2026-11-25): "not too many, not too little", "not too late, not too early, just right"; previews pending his ear

printed_fx_on_vocals.why: pooled post-phrase envelope: -23 dB re phrase at 50 ms, still -45 dB at ~600 ms (~40 dB/s, ~RT60 1.5 s) vs a dry known-answer test that falls 30 dB in 10 ms; median time to -40 dB 510-640 ms (leads/bg1), 340 ms (bg2). Tails are then truncated to digital zero 0.4-0.65 s after the phrase (region ends). Vocals are dual-mono (L=R), so no printed stereo FX

lossy_source.why: beat bandwidth 15.6 kHz (-40 dB) / 16.6 kHz (-60 dB), filename 'Y2Mate...160k'; ALL vocals stop at 16.0-16.5 kHz too (lossy export path)

copy_pasted_regions.what: beat: whole arrangement is a repeated loop

timing_vs_grid_ms_by_section._note: raw librosa onset medians vs the 1/16 grid; detector read +10 ms late on a known-answer test, so subtract ~10 ms; IQRs 25-40 ms

blockers: lossy beat (YouTube 160k rip) and lossy vocals (16 kHz bandwidth); air cannot be restored
printed reverb on all vocals, truncated to digital zero 0.4-0.65 s after phrases
808 fundamentals F1 43.7 / G1 49.1 / Bb1 58.5 / C2 65.9 Hz: 3 of 4 notes under 60 Hz, no 808 stem; 100-400 Hz envelope follows the 808 weakly (r=0.29)
copy-pasted vocal sections placed off the exact bar grid (+23.2 ms bars 65-73; -38.9 ms bars 89-91)
no clipping (0 runs), no DC issue (<1e-5), beat not mastered (-20.45 LUFS, PLR 17.1 dB, no flat tops)
possible producer tag / leaked vocals in the beat: not tested reliably
free type beat: lease/licence needed before release (not an audio check)
intake_findings.dry_vs_gated: regions/gated: 58% (leads) and 92-94% (BGs) of samples are exact digital zero; region edges are quiet (max -59 dBFS), but printed tails are cut to zero ~-45 dB below the phrase

vocal_roles.lead1_vs_lead2: call-and-response: alternate every 2 bars; only 10-12% of active frames overlap (hand-offs)
vocal_roles.bg1_vs_bg2: call-and-response with each other in bars 74-82 only (3% overlap)
vocal_roles.bg_vs_leads: not doubles or backing: 0-1% overlap with the leads; the 'Background lead' stems are a separate 9-bar bridge section sung on their own

tuning._calibration: known answers: snapped synthetic 92%, untuned drift 23%. Leads look partly pitch-corrected (Lead 1 more), BGs untuned; based on only ~12 s of confident pitch per lead

resonance_preview.tool: harmenv.py (What_Im_Posed_To_Do) pitch-independent harmonic envelope; Gate 1 must re-measure per section

lead_vs_beat_lu_target.why: no vocal stems for the references, so no reference delta. Artist taste: Wild Side -0.43 LU was 'too loud, not clean enough' (latest note), v9 at about -1.6 not yet approved; older WIPTD 0..+0.5 LU superseded. -1.0 sits inside the beat between the rejected and the untested value; measured on full-beat bars only. Vocal measured as the delivered dual-mono file

lead_vs_beat_lu_range.why: target +-0.5 LU, set before the render

midband_delta_db_target.why: 800 Hz-4 kHz vocal minus beat during singing: words clearly above the beat mids while the LU sits inside the beat; upper bound keeps it from sitting on top

lead_gain_db.why: common gain on both leads (after -18 dBFS gain staging) so the median full-beat section (A1/B1/A2/B3) lands on -1.0 LU vs the pocketed beat

beat_mid_dip.key: all vocals summed; depth = max * clip((env - (p95 - 20 dB))/10 dB, 0, 1)
beat_mid_dip.structure: Regalia-Mitra dynamic bell (x + (G-1)*bandpass), causal, zero latency
beat_mid_dip.why: masking (singing frames, after vocal gain): vocal-over-beat-mid margin by 1/3 octave {800: 9.5, 1008: 7.1, 1270: 5.9, 1600: 7.3, 2016: 3.3, 2540: 3.3, 3200: 2.2, 4032: -11.8}; 2-3.2 kHz sits 2.6-3.7 dB below the median margin, 4 kHz excluded (vocal source hole). Centre/width = those bands; depth = half the worst deficit (small move, cap 3 dB). Attack 1/128 note (13.9 ms), release 1/8 note (222.2 ms) so it closes in gaps. Note: the leads trade lines almost continuously, so inside vocal sections the dip is open most of the time (acts close to a static 1.8 dB cut there)

bus_offset_db.why: all frozen Gate 1 files (vocals and beat) carry one common -6 dB offset for headroom (attempt 2 clipped at 0 dBFS); balance unchanged; Gate 3 gain-stages the bus

pocket.why: lead vs beat per section and midband measured from the frozen files in gate1_exit_checks_v1.json

value.where: every region (turn) edge; 14 turns per lead, 2 per BG

edge_fades_ms.why: region starts are <= -59 dBFS and the first loud frame is >= 720 ms in, so 10 ms in touches nothing; region ends are chopped printed-reverb tails at -30.4 dB re the turn RMS (abrupt), so the longest allowed fade (15 ms) out. No breath gating.

working_level_rms_dbfs.why: standard starting point for predictable processors; raw active RMS -25.40 dBFS -> gain +7.40 dB

value.type: turn-level clip gain (gain steps sit in digital silence between turns)

rider.why: turn-level spread p90-p10 3.89 dB overall (within sections up to 4.7 dB, lead1 B1). A 250-400 ms RMS rider would ride inside turns and lift the printed reverb, so half the deviation from the stem's median turn level is corrected per whole turn, capped +-1.5 dB.

hpf.why: lowest sung fundamental 86.8 Hz (min of Gate 0 lowest-stable and p05 pitch); fc = 20% below (middle of the 15-25% guidance); 24 dB/oct because 12 dB/oct would cost >1 dB at the lowest note at any fc that still clears the 44-59 Hz 808 zone. Verified loss at lowest note in exit checks

eq_cuts.why: raw harmonic envelope: pooled hump +5.56 dB at 480 Hz (half-height ~430-530 Hz), every section +5.0..+6.2 (B1 peaks at 460). Sweep 1 (483/Q5) left the 440 Hz shoulder; sweep 2 (bell only) chose 472/Q3.8/-6; exit checks through the full chain then read pooled +2.62 and B1 +3.66. Sweep 3 (through the chain, depth fixed at the 6 dB cap, centre 466/474/482 x Q 3.4/4.2/5.0): 474 Hz Q4.2 brings B1 to ~2.2 and every section <= 3.0; NO centre/Q reaches the pooled +2.5 target at <= 6 dB (best ~2.67) -> documented as a limit, not deepened.

compressor_stages.threshold_rule: = measured active RMS of the compressor input (+0 dB)
compressor_stages.why: raw crest while singing 19.0 dB (spiky) but turn spread small; 18-setting sweep (thr -6/-3/0 re RMS, 2:1/3:1, 10/20/30 ms) under pre-set limits (punch +-1 dB, attack >= 90%, printed room <= raw+1 dB): this was the largest crest reduction that passed on both leads. Release = 1/16 note at 135 BPM (111.1 ms). BG chains use the same rule on their own RMS (verified in exit checks).

deesser.threshold: 97th percentile of the S-ness detector (band env - broadband env) over singing frames
deesser.placement: after compressor and tone EQ (LEARNINGS: de-ess last)
deesser.why: band = 1/4-octave bands whose p99 band-relative level is within ~1 dB of the stem maximum (raw scan); p90/p93 thresholds kept it on >20% of singing (sweep), p97 gives ~9-14%; release = 1/32 note (55.6 ms)

tone_boosts.why: take is very dark: 5-10 kHz vs 1-2 kHz = -18.6 dB vs beat -1.9 dB and refs -10.1/-2.8/0.0 dB (Kenshin WAVs). Closing that gap would lift lossy artifacts and sibilance (Kenshin hates harsh/scratchy), so a modest lift capped for a lossy 16 kHz source; flare and S-spike verified not above raw

voiced frames have a source hole at 3.6-5 kHz (-36 dB re 1 kHz in the median spectrum; lossy/printed processing) so presence is placed just below it, where the beat masks the vocal most (2-3.2 kHz margin lowest); +1 dB only (Kenshin: no harsh)

saturation.why: not needed: no measured phone-translation gain justifies it; Kenshin dislikes saturation/ampy vocals

pan.why: call-and-response leads and the bridge pair are single voices taking turns; no stereo width measured or requested

section_trim_db.why: B3 is sung ~2.5 dB hotter than A1; render attempt 1 put B3 at -0.34 LU, outside the pre-set range; trim applied to the B3 turns only (gain steps in digital silence)

input_stems.why: Alpha Gate 1 v2 DRY stems (all four vocals -1.5 dB vs v1 after Kenshin said the vocals were too loud and the beat hard to hear). NOT the v3 leads (they carry a printed lead plate). Gate 1 stems are frozen; nothing re-processed

value.front: dry lead (Lead 1/Lead 2, bridge voices), kick/snare/808 centre - NO reverb added to the lead (Kenshin + printed reverb already on stems)
value.middle: BG copy (telephone, centre, 15-20 dB under in 1-4 kHz)
value.back: BG reverb (1-bar hall, ducked), throws (band-passed, 30% L/R ping-pong)

depth_plan.why: Gate 2 depth plan, same in every vocal section

value.method: faster-whisper medium.en word timestamps per Gate 0 section chunk (summed Gate 1 vocals), deduped; lyric word count done against the ASR line (ASR dropped some words, e.g. "been" in A1). Throw-word starts and line ends from 10 ms energy envelopes (word activity = 300 Hz-4 kHz within 20 dB of the stem p95; the printed tail is -23 dB at 50 ms so it is excluded)
value.accuracy_note: ASR starts are only ~50 ms accurate (median |ASR - energy onset| 51 ms), so every timing that matters (BG entry dips, throw word starts, P-centers, line ends) is taken from the audio envelope, not from ASR. AUDIO ENGINEER & DAW timing_vs_grid.json was NOT used (known ~10 ms late detector, 25-40 ms spread). Lyrics are ASR, Kenshin must confirm
value.analysis_words_folder: analysis/words/ (AUDIO ENGINEER & DAW) only had a 6-word low-confidence lead1 file when checked, so it was not used

word_timing.why: no word timing existed; needed for BG entry at word 5/6 and line ends

built_from.value: copy of the Gate 1 v2 dry vocals of each section (Lead 1 + Lead 2; bridge: Background lead 1 + 2), 0 samples offset
built_from.why: Kenshin: perfectly in sync, repeating the main vocal; no 10-30 ms offset (LEARNINGS tunnel)

lead2.rule: finishes its own phrase across the boundary: word end + printed tail to digital zero (<=0.65 s, measured tail length)

lead1.rule: end of the stem's last region in this section (digital zero, printed tail already ends there)

lead2.rule: end of the stem's last region in this section (digital zero, printed tail already ends there)

lead2.rule: end of the stem's last region in this section (digital zero, printed tail already ends there)

entries.why: Kenshin: comes in about the 5th or 6th word of each verse and follows word for word to the end of the section; of words 5/6 the one with the deeper energy dip before it is used (cleanest fade-in, no word cut)

value.type: Butterworth 2nd order each, applied forward-backward (zero phase) -> 24 dB/oct, -6 dB at the corners

why.hp: Gate 1 harmonic envelope: box hump 430-530 Hz (peak 474-480). 600 Hz zero-phase HP puts 480 Hz at about -10.7 dB on the layer, so the copy adds no box (anti-tunnel)
why.lp: Gate 1 masking scan: the beat covers the lead most at 2.0-3.2 kHz (beat over vocal +2.7..+4.0 dB) and the lead presence bell is at 2.8 kHz, so the layer rolls off from 2.0 kHz (2.5 kHz -8.6 dB, 3.2 kHz -16 dB) and leaves the lead words that range
why.zero_phase: a causal band-pass would delay the copy by its group delay (~10-20 samples) = comb with the lead; filtfilt keeps it at 0 samples (verified by xcorr). Gentle 2nd-order sections keep pre-ringing small; checked as the layer is 15-20 dB under the lead

telephone.why: telephone tone requested; band derived from this voice (box) and the masking scan

value.key: all dry vocals, 1-4 kHz, depth = 3 dB * clip((env - (p95-20 dB))/10 dB,0,1)
value.why: Kenshin: dip the layer whenever the lead is active. LEARNINGS echo rule 8: duck lightly and fast (3-4 dB, release 80-120 ms); release = 1/16 note (111.1 ms). Capped at 3 dB because ATL showed riding a BG stem lifted tails/breaths ~12 dB (a ducker lifts tails relative to words by at most its depth)

ducker.why: Kenshin: dip the layer whenever the lead is active. LEARNINGS echo rule 8: duck lightly and fast (3-4 dB, release 80-120 ms); release = 1/16 note (111.1 ms). Capped at 3 dB because ATL showed riding a BG stem lifted tails/breaths ~12 dB (a ducker lifts tails relative to words by at most its depth)

level_db_under_lead_1to4k.why: LEARNINGS (ATL): Kenshin called BGs too loud at 7, 11 and 14 dB under the lead; v4 sat 18 dB under in 1-4 kHz (last version, not rejected). Brief: start LOW. Light = 20 dB (2 dB below the last unrejected value), fuller = 15 dB (5 dB step = clearly different by ear, still under the rejected 14 dB). Measured in 1-4 kHz, the band where he hears them (ATL lesson)

gain_db_applied.why: gain that puts the ducked telephone copy at the target under the v2 lead (relative, so it follows any later lead change)

pan.why: one copy of a centred lead; keeps vocal-bus mono correlation ~0.98-0.99

value.type: synthetic stereo hall (decorrelated exponential noise IR, L/R seeds 11/23), on the BG layer ONLY; lead stays dry

why.decay: Kenshin asked for dreamy/long: 1 bar (1.78 s) is longer than a 1/2-note plate but the tail is 60 dB down within one bar, so it never stacks over more than one 2-bar call-and-response turn (leads alternate every 2 bars, Gate 0)
why.predelay: printed reverb on the stems is -23 dB at 50 ms and -28 dB at 150 ms (Gate 0 tails.json); 1/32 (55.6 ms) would land on the densest printed tail, 1/16 (111.1 ms) lands after it so words stay ahead of the bloom
why.band: HP 600 Hz keeps the reverb out of the 430-530 Hz box (LEARNINGS v13: box-heavy reverb = tunnel); LP 3 kHz keeps it out of the S zone (de-esser bands 6-10 kHz) and the lead consonant zone
why.printed_fx: stems carry printed ~1.5 s reverb -> the added reverb is on the low BG copy only, not on the lead (far less than for dry vocals)

value.return_rule: clarity first: return gain chosen so the FULLER version measures 25 dB dry-to-reverb while singing (target >= 24 dB from LEARNINGS "slight reverb" + Kenshin pro clarity, +1 dB margin); light is then 30 dB. Attempt-1 rule (bloom = BG level) was too wet (fuller 20.2 dB)

return_ducker.why: release 1/8 note (222 ms) so the tail opens inside the 0.1-0.5 s turn gaps; 6 dB = clear bloom contrast; deeper ducking did not buy clarity at a fixed bloom level (attempt-1 sweep)

reverb.why: dreamy reverb on the BG copy ONLY (Kenshin + team: no reverb on the main lead, printed reverb already on the stems)

band.type: 2nd-order Butterworth forward-backward (zero phase, keeps the delay sample-exact)

value.levels: repeat 1 = -12 dB re the source word (600 Hz-3.6 kHz band RMS), then -5 dB and darker per repeat

why.band: HP 600 Hz above the 430-530 Hz box; LP 3.6 kHz = top of this source's usable band (lossy hole 3.6-5 kHz, Gate 1) so repeats sit behind the voice; each later repeat darker (LEARNINGS echo rule 7)
why.level: LEARNINGS: echoes 13-32 dB under the word went unheard (Interstate/Driftin), BG/echo too loud on ATL; -12 dB is the quiet edge of the 3-12 dB audible range = start low, then ask more/less
why.copy: whole word from its real start (LEARNINGS: copies that start mid-word "don't catch the words"), capped at one repeat interval so repeats never overlap (echo rule 3)
why.pan: repeat 1 30% L, repeat 2 30% R, repeat 3 centre (melodic-rap band-passed ping-pong; mono-checked)
why.collision: scan [t-0.15 s, t+repeat length] of all dry vocals (word activity, printed tails excluded) except the source word itself; a repeat whose P-center would reach the next word is omitted, a repeat whose tail would reach it is faded out 20 ms before the word

qc_thresholds_song_specific._note: Set BEFORE seeing results. Any later change needs a written reason in the report.
qc_thresholds_song_specific._gate1_note: Set before the Gate 1 render (S 2026-11-25, Alpha): hump pooled <= +2.5 dB, per section <= +3.0 dB (harmonic envelope at matched level); dip mean not below raw - 0.5 dB; punch +-1 dB, attack >= 90%; flare <= raw + 1 dB; S-spike <= raw; de-esser active 5-20%; printed-room tail and within-turn room <= raw + 1 dB; transient alignment <= 2 samples; brightness >= raw and <= raw + 3 dB.
qc_thresholds_song_specific._gate2_note: Set before the Gate 2 render (Plugin/Effect Pro): dry-to-reverb while singing >= 24 dB at both BG levels; BG copy 20 (light) / 15 (fuller) +-1 dB under the lead in 1-4 kHz; throw repeat-1 12 dB under its word, later repeats -5 dB each; every repeat >= -10 dB vs beat+dry in its band (audibility); vocal-bus mono corr >= 0.6, fold loss <= 1 dB; BG/lead transient shift <= 2 samples; tails < -60 dBFS.
